top_findings.title: No MCP protocol server — homegrown dispatch class, no SDK/entrypoint
top_findings.evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/server.py:31 BrazilianSoccerMCP.handle_request dispatches dotted string methods via if/elif; grep for MCP SDK/jsonrpc/stdio/list_tools/call_tool/Server( across all .py returns zero hits; no console_scripts entrypoint; only __main__ is in tests/test_brazilian_soccer_mcp.py:391; README.md:39-45 documents plain library usage.
top_findings.suggestion: Use the MCP Python SDK (fastmcp/mcp.server): register queries as @tool, expose a stdio/JSON-RPC transport, add a __main__ entrypoint.
